ABOUT THE ROLE

Under the direction of a licensed engineer and designated project leadership, the successful candidate will be responsible for analysis and design of structural systems/components in steel, concrete and masonry and an integral part of design teams.

Click here to learn more about our Engineering practice

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Independently perform structural engineering tasks on multiple projects.
  • Interface effectively with members of the design team to coordinate structural systems with overall building design.
  • Perform design calculations. Use relevant engineering software to design and document structural engineering systems.
  • Identify and apply structural code knowledge to structural engineering work. Design complete structural system within established design parameters.
  • Use Revit to develop BIM models for producing contract documents.
  • Perform complex design calculations and limited custom detailing.
  • Independently check shop drawings and calculations.
  • Review and edit design specifications.
  • Interface effectively with clients.
  • May attend and participate in construction meetings.
  • Perform field observations during construction phase requiring a physical walk through of the site.  Observations may be done independently.
  • May guide technicians and less experienced staff in execution of contract documents.
  • May assist in defining project budget and scope.
  • Must be willing to perform overtime work and travel.
  • May perform other duties as required.
 
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Minimum 4 years of related experience required.
  • Current PE and/or SE in the United States required. 
  • LEED AP is preferred.
  • Experience with concrete and steel required.
  • Knowledge of IBC and other national standard codes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Able to effectively handle multiple projects.
  • Experience in computer applications for engineering design programs (i.e. Revit, RAM, RISA) required.

We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
 
ABOUT WORKING HERE
